observations.body: Peter sees Jesus transfigured with Elijah and Moses, proposes three tents, hears the cloud’s voice, and descends under a command about telling.
observations.label: On the mountain

observations.body: The passage presents Witnessing and descending as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: Witnessing and descending

observations.body: The passage places The voice commands attention to the Son beside Witnessing and descending.
observations.label: The voice commands attention to the Son

payload.posture: Read Mark 9:2–13 as one movement in Peter's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states peter sees Jesus transfigured with Elijah and Moses, proposes three tents, hears the cloud’s voice, and descends under a command about telling. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Peter's story.
payload.title: On the mountain
